info.title: Hotels
info.description: HotelDo Hotels API provides static content and real-time availability for hotels, including endpoints to retrieve hotel details and search availability.\n\nThis specification documents the available endpoints, parameters, response schemas, and error handling.

get.description: Search for available hotels based on input criteria.

parameters.name: country_code
parameters.description: The country code of the traveler's point of sale, in ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format. This should represent the country where the shopping transaction is taking place.

parameters.name: checkin_date
parameters.description: Refers to the hotel check-in date and must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: checkout_date
parameters.description: Refers to the hotel check-out date and must be in the format YYYY-MM-DD.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Refers to the currency, which must be filled with three alphabetical digits. (E.g. "USD", "ARS")

parameters.name: hotels
parameters.description: List of hotel IDs, separated by commas (max. 100).

parameters.name: distribution
parameters.description: Passenger distribution. Each room’s passengers should be written as number_of_adults-children_ages. Children-age goes up to 17 years old. Rooms should be separated by “!”. E.g.: Means room 1 with 2 adults and room 2 with 2 adults and a 10-year-old child.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Refers to the language, which must be filled with two alphabetical digits.

parameters.name: ttl
parameters.description: Maximum time allowed for the connection. Minimum = 3000 ms, Maximum = 6200 ms.

parameters.name: refundable_only
parameters.description: If set to ‘true’, only refundable hotel rates will be quoted.

hotel_info.description: This structure is of type dictionary and returns hotel information.

location.description: an object that contains latitude and longitude values for the hotel location

meal_plan.description: Meal plan corresponding to the roompack (e.g., room only, breakfast included, all-inclusive, etc.).

reference.description: index of room elements contained in the roompack choice (first index == 1)

bed_options.description: list with all bedding options for the room

room_type_id.description: room id. These id should be used to map static content about the room

max_capacity.description: maximum pax capacity of the room

cancellation_policy.description: This structure is of type list and can return one or several rules regarding cancellation policies of the roompack

status.description: Represents the cancellation policy status at the moment the request is made

hours_before_penalty.description: hours prior to check in which status applies in case of cancelling in those conditions

cancellation_policy_rules.description: This structure is of type list and can return one or several rules regarding cancellation policies of the roompack. The penalty may be applied per night or as a percentage. Based on the information provided by the partner, the refund amount is determined. If no penalty is specified for that range, it is considered that no penalty applies.

penalty.description: contains the percentage of the total amount of the reservation that should be considered as charge in case of cancelling in theses conditions

anticipation.description: timeframe where the rules apply. it is a dictionary with “from” and “to” values measured in hours to check in.

currency.description: currency in which values will be expressed

total.description: total value of the roompack (subtotal + taxes). It does not include charges to be paid at destination

taxes.description: taxes corresponding to the roompack price

taxes_detail.description: list with code and amount pairs

code.description: This field can have different possible values, which are:

binding_public_rate_enabled.description: if set to true, “amount” value is the mínimum price that the partner should sell the item

saving.description: Details of the promotional savings associated with the product.

tags.description: Used to identify products associated with a promotion.
